entwurf.thema: AI coding for beginners: your first 10 minutes with Claude Code
entwurf.beschreibung: A quick, humor‑filled guide that shows a complete beginner how to install Claude Code, get a snippet, and understand its limits—all in under two minutes.

teile.name: Hook
teile.suche: Claude Code install, AI coding assistant
teile.text: Ever tried coding without a clue? It feels like juggling flaming keyboards while your coffee watches in the morning.
teile.szene: A bright kitchen at dawn, a frazzled person holds a laptop, steam rises from a mug, light streams through a window, painted urban poster style.
teile.bildtext: Person looking bewildered at laptop, coffee beside them.

teile.name: Problem
teile.text: You open a fresh project, but the first function throws mysterious errors, and Stack Overflow just sighs for you.
teile.szene: A cramped home office, code errors flash red on screen, a frustrated developer sighs, neon glow from monitors, urban poster vibe.

teile.name: Solution Intro
teile.suche: Claude Code overview, AI code generation
teile.text: Claude Code steps in, reads your repo, and writes a working snippet before you can finish your coffee.
teile.szene: A stylized terminal window glows, Claude avatar appears, code flows onto the screen, sunrise light filters in.

teile.name: Install
teile.suche: Claude install script, CLI version check
teile.text: In your terminal, run the install script, then type 'claude --version' to confirm it’s alive and ready now.
teile.szene: Close‑up of hands typing a curl command, progress bar invisible, terminal prompt shows version number, morning light highlights the screen.

teile.name: Generate Code
teile.suche: generate JSON parser, AI code snippet
teile.text: Ask Claude, 'Create a function that parses JSON safely,' and watch it generate code with built‑in tests instantly.
teile.szene: Animated speech bubble from Claude, code appears line by line, test results flash green, developer smiles.
teile.bildtext: Claude outputting a safe JSON parser.

teile.name: Limitation
teile.suche: Claude MCP setup, private API access
teile.text: Remember, Claude can’t access private APIs without MCP setup, so you’ll need to connect those tools yourself later.
teile.szene: A puzzle of API icons floats above a laptop, Claude looks puzzled, a toolbox labeled MCP sits nearby.

teile.name: CTA
teile.suche: like share save, tech video CTA
teile.text: Like, share, and save this video, please! for more
teile.szene: The presenter points at a bright button, urban poster backdrop, confetti pops, camera zooms out.
